scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run design:lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @no-pi-no-gang/contracts && npm run build --workspace @no-pi-no-gang/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @no-pi-no-gang/testkit && npm run typecheck --workspace no-pi-no-gang && npm run typecheck --workspace @no-pi-no-gang/web
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test --workspace @no-pi-no-gang/web && npm run test --workspace no-pi-no-gang
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @no-pi-no-gang/contracts && npm run build --workspace @no-pi-no-gang/testkit && node scripts/build-gateway.mjs
scripts.verify:quick: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run pack:check
scripts.verify:real-pi: npm run build && npm run test:real-pi
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:quick && npm run test:real-pi && npm run test:acceptance:chromium
